paragraphs: Heathrow’s ambition to refine airport operations through data science mirrors my recent work building predictive models that translate complex data into actionable insights.
I built scikit‑learn pipelines and LSTM/BiRNN/CNN models in TensorFlow/Keras, deploying them as FastAPI services in Docker, ensuring smooth integration into existing workflows.

I proposed and prototyped an MCP‑based agentic tool in Python, using FastMCP, Ollama gpt‑oss:20b, PostgreSQL and GitHub Actions CI, and presented it in a live stakeholder demo for a Madrid‑based product start‑up client.
